Bloomberg Delays Indian Government Bond Inclusion in Global Index

Bloomberg has again postponed a decision on including Indian government bonds in its Global Aggregate Index. Global investors have acknowledged India's progress in market access but are awaiting evidence that recent operational reforms are effective in daily trading. This deferral means Indian sovereign bonds will not be added to the index at this time. The decision was based on the need for reforms to prove their efficacy in real-world trading conditions.
